title: Verify: App emits interact and transition from game actions unit tests
summary: Unit tests prove App forwards actions to reactToPhaser
description: Add an App test using the existing fake Phaser host pattern from appObjectClick.test.tsx and a spy on reactToPhaser.emit.
acceptance_criteria: Choosing an action emits playAnimation boy interact
A scene id change emits transitionTo and no change does not
technical_constraints: Phaser, BootScene and createGame mocked; no browser

steps.action: Create the file copying the mocks and setup of appObjectClick.test.tsx (L1-L50), mock ../src/api/client getCurrentRound to resolve a round, spy on reactToPhaser.emit. Test 'action emits playAnimation': click Begin, emit phaserToReact objectClick for 'bed', click the first ActionMenu action button and assert the spy was called with 'playAnimation', {target:'boy',name:'interact'}.

Add test 'scene change emits transitionTo': before clicking the action, make the action change state.sceneId by setting useGameStore.setState in a mocked act path (spy useGame act via vi.mock of ../src/runtime/useGame returning state.sceneId 'bedroom' then store sceneId 'library'); assert emit called with 'transitionTo', {sceneId:'library'}. Add test 'unchanged scene emits no transitionTo' asserting no transitionTo call.
